_meta.description: Country -> official regulator/law reference, used by privacy_discovery_service.py as a Tier-2 lookup (after the rich iapp_privacy_crawler.py adapters, before falling back to general search+recall synthesis). Hand-curated ONCE from publicly known official government/regulator sites, using IAPP's Global Privacy Directory (https://iapp.org/resources/global-privacy-directory) as a one-time reference for which jurisdictions to prioritize -- this file is a static reference the app reads locally; nothing in this codebase fetches IAPP itself on an ongoing basis. All fetching this file drives targets the official URLs listed below, not IAPP.
_meta.coverage: Starting set only -- the ~24 richer adapters in iapp_privacy_crawler.py take priority and are not duplicated here. Countries not covered fall through to general search+AI-recall discovery (privacy_discovery_service.discover_and_store_jurisdiction), which is expected and safe -- those results are flagged is_verified=false for review.
_meta.superseded_by: This file was the one-time seed for the privacy_source_registry DB table (migration 20260725_privacy_source_registry.py) -- privacy_discovery_service.py's Tier-2 lookup now queries that table at runtime, not this file. Kept here as the historical record of the original 22-country seed; grow the DB table directly (batched curation) rather than re-editing this file.
